name: dp-gnosis
description: Retrieval over a curated markdown atom vault. Liftable unit: code here, vault at gnosis/, runtime at .dp-gnosis/.
comment:dependencies: better-sqlite3 backs the FTS5 adapter. It already resolves from the repo root, so nothing new is installed — it is declared here so this package stays a liftable unit (decision N-1) rather than depending on an undeclared ambient package.
comment:optionalDependencies: Adapter-gated packages (minisearch + stemmer, @lancedb/lancedb) land here ONLY after their COMMON.md §IX round is approved (plan T-18 / T-20). They are loaded by lazy dynamic import so a missing one skips its adapter instead of breaking the suite.
